title: Empty state with context and next action
summary: Explain why a meaningful collection is empty and offer the most relevant way to populate, configure, or understand it.
problem: Blank containers and generic illustrations leave users unsure whether setup is incomplete, filters are active, access is missing, or there is simply no data.
use_when: A meaningful product area can contain zero objects or data
First-use and post-deletion emptiness require different guidance
avoid_when: The absence is self-explanatory and adding content would distract
rationale: Empty states are part of normal product lifecycle.
The next action should reflect the cause of emptiness.

use_if: A meaningful product area can contain zero objects or data
First-use and post-deletion emptiness require different guidance
prefer_alternatives_if: The state is actually loading, failure, or zero search results and should use that more specific state

requirements: Provide explanatory text; do not depend on illustration.
Keep the recommended action a normal operable control.
Distinguish first-use from filtered, access, or failure emptiness.
Offer one primary next action when there is a clear path.
Avoid marketing copy that obscures the state.
